packageRules.description: org.scala-tools.testing:specs is the pre-Scala-2.9 publication, where the Scala binary version is baked into the version string (1.6.2.2_1.5.0) instead of a _2.x suffix. Renovate reads that as a semver segment, so the comparison is meaningless for this Scala 2.8-era pom. See closed PR #4.
